tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Audit a website for AI agents and AI search (AEO/GEO): scan it the way ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity fetch it and score it 0-100 (60 core points plus 40 for the job). Checks robots.txt rules for AI bots, bot walls and firewalls, server-rendered content, structured data, llms.txt, sitemap, pricing a

tools.name: get_fixes
tools.description: Return a ready-to-run task list for a coding agent that fixes every failed agent-readiness and AI-search check on the site (for example adding llms.txt, unblocking AI crawlers, adding structured data), biggest first, with how to verify each change. Same scan as check_site.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: The full 50-item checklist for getting recommended by AI assistants and letting their agents sign up, grouped by area, with how to pass each item. Pass kind "personal" for the list for a person's own site (portfolio, blog, GitHub Pages).

tools.name: get_standard
tools.description: Every check in the AgentsReady score with its points and fix: the 60 core points and the 40 points for each job (recommend, buy, signup, api, personal).

tools.name: lookup_vendor
tools.description: Where a software vendor ranks in the AgentsReady category rankings (CRM, help desk, payments and 17 more): score, rank, bot wall, MCP server and biggest gap.
